# <span id="aanchor433"></span> Message Directory

[&lt;&lt; Back](../Message%20Directory.md) \| [100](Location%20100.md) \| <a href="#" class="selected">10000</a>

## Location Messages

### 10119 - 10121

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="50100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10119 - Duplicate ticket exists for date and location</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="50100">

When importing a ticket that has an effective date and location that matches a ticket that already exists in FLOWCAL, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Duplicate ticket exists for date and location
- Data 1 Usage: File Name @ Machine
- Data 2 Usage: Ticket ID
- Data 3 Usage: Effective Date
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="50101">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10120 - Database record exists with duplicate ticket ID and time stamp; "Create Revisions" option not set</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="50101">

When the FLOWCAL option for Create Revisions is not checked and a ticket is imported that has an effective date and ticket ID that matches a ticket that already exists in FLOWCAL, the ticket will fail to import and this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Database record exists with duplicate ticket ID and time stamp; "Create Revisions" option not set
- Data 1 Usage: File Name @ Machine
- Data 2 Usage: Ticket ID
- Data 3 Usage: Effective Date
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="50102">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10121 - Ticket import failed for closed month (PPAs are not allowed)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="50102">

When importing a ticket onto a location where the effective date of the ticket falls within a month that the location has been closed and the system is configured to not allow PPAs, the ticket will fail to import and this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Ticket import failed for closed month (PPAs are not allowed)
- Data 1 Usage: File Name @ Machine
- Data 2 Usage: Ticket ID
- Data 3 Usage: Location Name
- Data 4 Usage: Effective Date
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

</div>
